name: Vampire
description: A vampire is an undead creature sustained by the blood of the living, stalking the night with a blend of agility and predatory instincts. While not as powerful as the ancient vampire lords to whom they are enthralled, they still possess enhanced strength and endurance and a firm control over their bloodlust.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: The vampire swings at a creature with it's sharp claws, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Leap
actions.description: The vampire jumps to a space within 4 units without triggering reactions.

actions.name: Vampire Bite
actions.description: The vampire bites a creature, dealing physical damage. If this attack is made against a humanoid or beast, and the damage is not completely mitigated, the vampire gains health equal to the damage dealt and their blood requirements are satisfied for the day. The vampire can only benefit from the recovering health in this way twice per day.

actions.name: Dark Gift
actions.description: After successfully dealing damage with the Vampire Bite action against a humanoid target, the vampire attempts to pass on their vampirism. The affected creature must make a resilience check of 10 or higher or become diseased. If the creature dies while under the effect of this disease and is not brought back to life within 1d4 days, they either rise as a vampire thrall or gain the Vampirism Module.

actions.name: Offhand Claw
actions.description: The vampire swings at a creature with it's sharp offhand claws, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Undead Fortification
actions.description: In response to being the target of a true hit, the vampire downgrades it by one tier.

actions.name: Dual Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving it's area of control, the vampire uses their Claw action and Offhand Claw free action against them.

traits.name: Blood Requirements
traits.description: The vampire requires at least 1 vial of blood from a humanoid or beast per day, else they gain 1 Tier of Exhaustion. Upon reaching the 3rd tier of Exhaustion, the vampire must make a resilience check of 8 or higher, or they gain the Stasis condition until given blood. On a success, the vampire remains at 2 Tiers of Exhaustion.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: The vampire takes 2d4 true damage while ending their turn within sunlight while they are not wearing a lead-lined cloak. While suffering from this affect, the vampire cannot benefit from the health restoration from their Dark Gift free action.
